# Video Speed Shortcuts 0.3.2

### Improvements

- Added a focused shortcut recorder dialog with explicit save, cancel, and restore controls.
- Added per-shortcut reset controls that safely handle conflicts with existing bindings.
- Improved shortcut conflict feedback and preserved recording drafts when saving fails.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/chenghsj/video-speed-shortcuts/compare/v0.3.1...v0.3.2
